title: CreateUserRequest
description: Payload to create a new Control Room user account

username.description: Unique username for the new user

email.description: Email address associated with the user account

password.description: Initial password for the user (not required for SSO-only users)

roles.description: List of role IDs to assign to the user

licenseFeatures.description: License feature types assigned to the user (e.g., ATTENDED, UNATTENDED)

enabled.description: Whether the user account is active and can log in
